faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ANRF Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the ANRF Junior Research Fellow position at IIT(ISM) Dhanbad is 25th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. in Mathematics with at least 60% marks from a UGC recognized University/Institute and must be qualified in NET/GATE.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the ANRF Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the ANRF Junior Research Fellow position as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the ANRF Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 37,000/- + HRA for the first two years and Rs. 42,000/- + HRA for the third year.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the ANRF Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process for this position will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT(ISM) Dhanbad located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology (Indian School of Mines) Dhanbad is located in Dhanbad, Jharkhand.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is ANRF/ECRG/2025/003950/PMS.

faq.question: Q10. Does IIT(ISM) Dhanbad offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Age relaxation details are as per the norms of the Govt. of India/DST-ANRF for JRF recruitment.
